create.title: Affine Abel reduction and unmatched character-hyperbola crossings
create.statement_tex: Let A_(X,Xi)(n)=sum_(j|n)chi_4(j)Xi(j/sqrt(X)) for n>=1 and zero for n<=0, c_X=sum_j chi_4(j)Xi(j/sqrt(X))/j, n_0=floor(X), and define the all-integer D by D(n_0)=0 and D(n)-D(n-1)=A_(X,Xi)(n)-c_X. For W_n=K((n-X)/(2T)), the sampled zero mode gives sum_n A(n)W_n=sum_n D(n)(W_n-W_(n+1)). Moreover c_X<<_Xi X^(-1/2). For integral 0<v<inf(supp Xi)sqrt(X), period-four pairing gives D(n_0+v)=sum_r Xi((4r+1)/sqrt(X))(C_(4r+1)(v)-C_(4r+3)(v))+O_Xi(1+v/sqrt(X)), where C_j(v) indicates that (n_0,n_0+v] contains a multiple of j. The survivor has coefficients 0,+1,-1. Its X^(1/4+epsilon) signed bound is open; at nu=2/5 the unsaved factor is X^(1/20)=H/L.
